description: Frozen snapshot of every SVF2 (OTG) fragment world matrix of the Audubon clash-test fixtures, read live with FragmentList.getWorldMatrix in APS Viewer 7.124.2 on 2026-10-07 (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-07-svf2-nonuniform-fragment-clearance-design.md section 1). Each model is a base64 little-endian Float32Array of fragCount x 16 column-major elements (every element was float32-exact at capture). SVF2 normalizes every mesh to the [-0.5, 0.5]^3 unit cube.
